hero.h1: Budget airport transfers in Marrakech & Fes
hero.lead: Skip the taxi-rank haggling. Fixed prices, a driver waiting with your name at arrivals, and both a budget shared shuttle and a private door-to-door option at both Marrakech Menara (RAK) and Fès–Saïs (FEZ) airports.

sections.lead: Marrakech Menara is just 15–20 minutes from the medina — but airport taxi ranks are notorious for inflated, unmetered fares. Book ahead instead and pay a fixed price with a driver already tracking your flight.

cards.title: Shared Airport Shuttle
cards.blurb: A budget shared shuttle with other arriving travelers, direct to your riad or hotel in the medina or Gueliz.

cards.title: Private Airport Transfer
cards.blurb: Your own vehicle direct to your accommodation, any time of day or night, no waiting for other passengers.

sections.lead: Fès–Saïs airport sits about 15km from the Fes medina. Both our shared and private transfer options include flight tracking, so a delayed landing won't leave you stranded.

cards.title: Shared Airport Shuttle
cards.blurb: A budget shared shuttle direct to your riad or hotel near the Fes medina, split with other arriving travelers.

cards.title: Private Airport Transfer
cards.blurb: Your own vehicle direct to your accommodation, any time of day or night, no waiting for other passengers.

steps.title: Send your flight details
steps.text: Share your flight number, arrival date, and time through the contact form.

steps.title: We track your flight
steps.text: Your driver monitors the flight in real time, so early or delayed arrivals are covered.

steps.title: Meet at arrivals
steps.text: Your driver waits in the arrivals hall with a name sign — no need to find your own taxi.

steps.title: Direct to your door
steps.text: Straight to your riad or hotel at a fixed price, agreed before you land.

faq.a: Yes — you agree the price when you book, with no meter and no surprise add-ons on arrival, unlike most airport taxi ranks.

faq.q: What if my flight is delayed?
faq.a: Both shared and private transfers track your flight, so your driver adjusts pickup time automatically at no extra cost.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: One large suitcase and one carry-on per person is included. Traveling with extra or oversized luggage? Let us know when booking so we can arrange the right vehicle.

faq.q: Can I book a transfer without booking a tour?
faq.a: Absolutely — airport transfers are available as a standalone booking, no tour required.

faq.q: Do you also offer departure transfers?
faq.a: Yes, both arrival and departure transfers are available at the same fixed prices for Marrakech and Fes.

cta.p: Send us your flight details and we'll have a driver waiting.
